fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Search for usage of reg or Powershell by non-privileged users to modify service configuration in registry
fields.name: Non-privileged Usage of Reg or Powershell
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.cmdline contains "reg " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "add") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "powershell" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "set-itemproperty" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " sp " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "new-itemproperty")) and ((tgt.process.integrityLevel in ("Medium","S-1-16-8192")) and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "ControlSet" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "Services") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "ImagePath" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "FailureCommand" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "ServiceDLL"))))
